faqs.answer: The School of Computer Applications (SCA) at Dayananda Sagar University was established in 2016-17 to prepare students for careers in Information Technology. It offers BCA, BCA in AI and Data Sciences, B.Sc. Data Science and B.Sc. Cyber Security at undergraduate level, and MCA, M.Sc. Data Science and M.Sc. Cyber Security at postgraduate level. Its tracks cover AI, Data Science, Cyber Security, Cloud Computing and Web and Mobile Application Development.

faqs.answer: Dayananda Sagar University (DSU) in Bengaluru was created by an Act of the Karnataka State in 2014, building on the Dayananda Sagar Institutions founded in the 1960s by the late Sri R.
